items.title: VC funding in Europe falls short at early-stage investment hurdles
items.summary: As larger late-stage funding gets a boost, biotechs struggle to secure Series A rounds to progress towards clinical development.

items.title: Pentagon drops WuXi AppTec from Chinese military company list
items.summary: The decision means the CRDMO will no longer face any US national security repercussions.

items.title: How Kenya has become a clinical logistics hub for sub-Saharan Africa
items.summary: With Africa possessing immense potential for clinical trials that is largely untapped, Kenya has emerged as a strategic hub for clinical logistics.

items.title: China’s burgeoning novel medicines success presents opportunity for Europe
items.summary: Experts at BIO-Europe 2026 say that Europe should seize the opportunity to rethink its legacy approaches to keep up as China races ahead.

items.title: Delix Therapeutics raises $100m for zalsupindole development
items.summary: Delix Therapeutics has secured $100m in an oversubscribed Series C financing round to fund the development of Zalsupindole, an orally bioavailable neuroplastogen.
